method: Read-only old-vs-current identity/formula audit. Exact old GTIN primary dm country pages and fresh current dm DE direct/search rows are required; name, package or DAN alone are not treated as continuity. Correction: identical displayed ingredient sets are declared-INCI continuity only; order changes can matter. Differing fragrance/allergen declarations are not treated as proof of chemical reformulation.
